id: File:1912 US Flag specification 1.jpg
title: File:1912 US Flag specification 1.jpg
description: Construction sheet for the 1912 (48-star)  Flag of the United States .  This is presumably the specification from the U.S. Navy published in conjunction with  Executive Order 1637 , which defined the flag. From page 19 of the archive.org version of   The Stars and Stripes  , 1914, by Charles West Stewart.  This is printed there alongside Executive Order 1637, which defined the flag, so presumably this is the specification from the Navy Department mentioned in the order.
found_by: Category:Executive orders of William Howard Taft

id: File:1912 US Flag specification 2.jpg
title: File:1912 US Flag specification 2.jpg
description:
Second part of the construction sheet for the 1912 (48-star)  Flag of the United States , which deals with associated items used on U.S. Navy ships (ensigns and pennants).  This is presumably the specification from the U.S. Navy published in conjunction with  Executive Order 1637 , which defined the flag.
 
The special boat flags were discontinued in 1916; they are not mentioned in  Executive Order 2390  which replaced this one. From page 25 of the archive.org version of   The Stars and Stripes  , 1914, by Charles West Stewart.  This is printed there alongside Executive Order 1637, which defined the flag, so presumably this is the specification from the Navy Department mentioned in the order.
found_by: Category:Executive orders of William Howard Taft

id: File:1916 US President's Flag Exec Order 2390.jpg
title: File:1916 US President's Flag Exec Order 2390.jpg
description:
Drawing of the 1916 Flag of the President of the United States; the flag was defined in  s:Executive Order 2390  and this was an attachment to that order which demonstrated the design.  Gouache on paper, 12" x 16".
 
This design was used until 1945. National Archives  Designs for Democracy  exhibit;  this page .  Citation page  here , full image page  here , direct image url  [1] .   Part of Executive Order 2390.

description:
Scope and content:   The Volstead Act implemented and provided an enforcement apparatus for the Eighteenth Amendment, which forbade the manufacture, transportation, and sale of "intoxicating beverages." Circumvention of the law led to bootlegging and the rise of organized crime. 
  General notes:   The text of all federal laws is published in the U.S. Statutes at Large, a multivolume publication at libraries nationwide. The Volstead Act is found in volume 41 of Statutes at Large, pp. 305-32  U.S. National Archives and Records Administration

Map illustration of the   Clearwater National Forest   in Idaho. 
 
  This map is an attachment to  Executive Order 842  which originally defined the forest in 1908.   A copy of the printed executive order is attached at the bottom left.  The map was modified from one included with a presidential proclamation from November 6, 1906, which defined the original Coeur D'Alene National Forest, part of which was used to create the Clearwater National Forest (see  File:United States Statutes at Large  From PDF version of   Ranger Stations on the Idaho Panhandle National Forests, by Cort Sims  .  Page 66. Direct PDF URL  here .

id: File:Collaborative network evolution the Los Angeles terrorism early warning group (IA collaborativenet109452964).pdf
title: File:Collaborative network evolution the Los Angeles terrorism early warning group (IA collaborativenet109452964).pdf
description:
This study bridges the narrow divide between collaboration theory and networking and views organizations as a source of collaborative processes. Social network analysis is applied to determine how the Los Angeles Terrorism Early Warning Group (TEW) evolved from a small group of actors to a diverse, county-wide network bridging public-private, local-state-federal, and functional divides. The TEW demonstrates an example of organizational problem solving where a network facilitated collaboration     Internet Archive identifier:  collaborativenet109452964

description:
The U.S. military cooperates more with the Colombian military than the Mexican military in combating drug trafficking in the Western Hemisphere. This thesis analyzes the international relations theories of liberalism, realism, and constructivism to help explain why. Historical relationships matter in cooperation. title: File:Congressional oversight of homeland security- help or hinderance? (IA congressionalove1094527903).pdf
description:
Congressional oversight of homeland security constantly receives harsh criticism from scholars and the media for being disjointed and overbearing. Critics often cite the numerous committees and members of Congress that have jurisdiction over the Department of Homeland Security. They allege that this disparate oversight leads to conflicting direction, inefficiency, and wasted resources. While there is room for improvement, congressional oversight is not as fragmented and ineffective as critics     Internet Archive identifier:  congressionalove1094527903

id: File:Don't ask, don't tell - policy analysis and interpretation (IA dontskdonttellpo1094542888).pdf
title: File:Don't ask, don't tell - policy analysis and interpretation (IA dontskdonttellpo1094542888).pdf
description:
The  Department  of  Defense  issued  directives  in  December  of  1993  revising the  policy  on  homosexuals  in  the  military.  The  policy,  dubbed  "don't  ask,  don't tell,"  makes  a  distinction  between  sexual  conduct  and  sexual  orientation.  Sexual orientation  is  considered  a  private  matter  while  sexual  misconduct  is  an  offense  that remains  punishable  by  separation.  The  new  policy  also  prevents  investigations solely  for  the  purpose  of  determining  se     Internet Archive identifier:  dontskdonttellpo1094542888

id: File:Executive Order 9981 dated July 26, 1948, Establishing the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services - DPLA - cfebd9153dfafb906c36564baed37b99 (page 1).jpg
title: File:Executive Order 9981 dated July 26, 1948, Establishing the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services - DPLA - cfebd9153dfafb906c36564baed37b99 (page 1).jpg
description: On July 26, 1948, President Harry S. Truman signed this executive order banning segregation in the Armed Forces. Executive Order 9981 stated that "there shall be equality of treatment and opportunity for all persons in the armed forces without regard to race, color, religion, or national origin." It established the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services to recommend revisions to military regulations in order to implement this policy.         Catalog record

id: File:Explainer – Trump Travel Ban.webm
title: File:Explainer – Trump Travel Ban.webm
description: A U.S. federal appeals court will be considering arguments to reinstate President Donald Trump's executive order that temporarily bans immigration from seven Muslim-majority countries. Last week, a federal judge blocked implementation of the order, and the Trump administration is asking a three-judge appeals panel to overturn the ruling. While the courts consider the issue, questions still linger about the choice of countries named in the order. VOA's Masood Farivar explains.  www.voanews.com

id: File:Flag of the United States specification.jpg
title: File:Flag of the United States specification.jpg
description:
This diagram of the  flag of the United States  was given in Executive Order 10834, by Dwight D. Eisenhower, on August 21, 1959 (see  w:List of United States federal executive orders ).  It appears in the United States Code, title 4, chapter 1
  The law specifies the lengths in the diagram as follows:
 
  Hoist (width) of flag: A = 1.0 
 Fly (length) of flag: B = 1.9 
 Hoist (width) of Union: C = 0.5385 (7/13) 
 Fly (length) of Union: D = 0.76 
 E = F = 0.054 
 G = H = 0.063 
 Diameter of star:  Text of executive order here .
found_by: Category:Executive orders of Dwight D. Eisenhower

title: File:Implementation of Total Quality Leadership in the Turkish Army Academy. (IA implementationof109459333).pdf
description:
Total Quality Leadership (TQL) activities commenced in the Turkish Army Academy in early 1997. This thesis investigates the current implementation status of TQL in Turkish Army Academy through a TQL Climate Survey and interviews. The data suggest that while quality is important to the Academy, the officers are not confident that the TQL program will help them achieve it. The compatibility of the TQL philosophy with Turkish Army Academy is discussed. Recommendations are also provided.

It was renamed the Johnston Island National Wildlife Refuge in 1940, and control was transferred to the Navy and eventually the Air Force (who greatly modified the island to build an airstrip), before becoming part of the Pacific Remote Islands National Wildlife Refuge Complex in 2004 (now the  Pacific Remote Islands Marine National Monument ). From  U.S. Air Force Final Environmental Statement on Disposition of Orange Herbicide by Incineration , a report from 1974 on the then-planned destruction of the Agent Orange stockpiles, in the appendices.

title: File:Oregon Treaty - NARA - 299808.tif
description:
Scope and content:   This treaty divided the Oregon country between the United States and Canada at the 49th parallel. It granted to the United States land that would later comprise the entire states of Oregon, Washington, and Idaho, as well as portions of Montana and Wyoming. Pictured is the signature page and President Polk's proclamation announcing the treaty. 
  General notes:   Treaty documentation is available in "Perfected International Treaties, 1778-1945," National Archives Microfi  U.S. National Archives and Records Administration

id: File:On March 30, 1942, 227 Japanese Americans were forcibly removed from their homes by soldiers carrying out Executive Order 9066 (ccad3f6a-1dd8-b71b-0b17-a5b39f14e749).JPG
title: File:On March 30, 1942, 227 Japanese Americans were forcibly removed from their homes by soldiers carrying out Executive Order 9066 (ccad3f6a-1dd8-b71b-0b17-a5b39f14e749).JPG
description:
A group of visitors gather to the right of the curved Memorial wall. 
 On March 30, 1942, 227 Japanese Americans were forcibly removed from their homes by soldiers carrying out Executive Order 9066. Today, the Memorial stands on the site were men, women and children waited to begin their long journey to an unknown destination for an indeterminate amount of time. 
  Keywords: nps centennial    NPGallery

description: Illustration of the Salt Plains Wildlife Refuge in Oklahoma. This map is an attachment to  s:Executive Order 5314  which created the refuge in 1930.  The reservation was later extended, and is today the  Salt Plains National Wildlife Refuge . From   Herbert Hoover: Proclamations and Executive Orders, March 4, 1929 to March 4, 1933   (Book 1), University of Michigan scan, on page 546.  Extracted from their PDF version.

id: File:Saint Lazaria Reservation EO 1040 illustration..jpg
title: File:Saint Lazaria Reservation EO 1040 illustration..jpg
description: Illustration of the Saint Lazaria Reservation, Alaska. This map is an attachment to  s:Executive Order 1040  which originally defined the reservation in 1909.  It became the Saint Lazaria National Wildlife Refuge, and in 1980 was incorporated into the  Alaska Maritime National Wildlife Refuge . From  Pamphlets on Forestry, Fish and Game, Volume 6 , Google Books scan, on page 141 (reprint of a USDA circular).

The focus of this thesis is to review the use of the Government-wide commercial bank card known as the International Merchant Purchase Agreement Card (I.M.P.A.C.) at the Naval Air Warfare Center, Weapons Division (NAWCWPNS), China Lake, CA. The intent of the study is to analyze the bank card program. description:

title: File:Travelers From Seven Countries Experience Difficulties on Travel to US.webm
description: U.S. airport authorities began implementing President Donald Trump's executive action aimed at preventing terrorists from entering the United States. Several hundred people were detained at entry airports Saturday and Sunday, sparking a wave of protests at home and abroad. The executive order singling out seven Muslim majority countries has baffled citizens in those countries. VOA's Zlatica Hoke has more.  http://www.voanews.com/a/3698126.html

id: File:Trump Travel Ban Presents Dilemma for Europe's Leaders.webm
title: File:Trump Travel Ban Presents Dilemma for Europe's Leaders.webm
description: U.S. President Donald Trump’s ban on travelers from seven majority-Muslim countries has European governments scrambling to respond to the measure. The ban presents a major dilemma for these governments, under pressure by their growing Muslim populations on side and, on the other, rising nationalist sentiments among those who oppose further Muslim immigration.  VOA Europe Correspondent Luis Ramirez reports.  https://www.voanews.com/a/trump-travel-ban-presents-dilemma-for-europe-leaders/3699122.html
